subject: - Remove unused variable from test (#379)
reason: The change only removes unused variables and magic numbers from a unit test file (thread_pool_test.cc) and adds `inline` to two explicit template specializations in debug.h to fix ODR/linkage for a header-defined function. The function bodies are unchanged, so no command, reply, indexing, replication or persistence behavior of the valkey-search module differs between the parent and the change; there is nothing a runtime scenario could observe.
